create_abstract_model: create an AbstractModel instance with a pretrained model, model name, and device configuration
get_image_embeddings: get image embeddings from a pretrained vision model for zero-shot classification
get_text_embeddings: get text embeddings from a pretrained language model for zero-shot classification
get_zeroshot_predictions: get zero-shot classification predictions by combining image embeddings with text weights
get_preprocess_transforms: get image preprocessing transforms including resize, crop, normalization, and grayscale-to-RGB conversion
